about:
Atrium Corporation, based in Johnstown, Ohio, was founded in 1996. The company operates as a private-label apparel and accessory manufacturer, delivering customized services from concept to consumer. Ownership structure and founder names have not been disclosed in public sources.

The company provides full-service product development and manufacturing for apparel and accessories, including merchandising, business-to-business distribution, and retail-ready services. Clients are partnered with a team of brand-building merchants and a lead designer to study the product and guide development through production. It manages the process from concept through to consumer delivery, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Atrium serves brands and retailers in the apparel and accessories sectors, offering B2B distribution and retail-ready solutions. Its clients include businesses seeking private-label manufacturing and merchandising support. The company emphasizes customized services from concept to consumer, positioning itself as a full-service partner for brand-building.

The company's service model is built around a full-service merchandising approach and retail-ready distribution, aiming to streamline the path from product concept to shelf.
